map.依次闪现一串数字（每位约 1 秒），消失后要求原样复述；长度从短到长递增，记录达: A string of digits flashes one at a time (about 1 second each), and after they disappear you repeat it exactly; the length grows from short to long and the longest length reached is recorded. ...
map.短时记忆：依次闪现数字串，闭眼复述。: Short-term memory: digits flash in sequence and you repeat them with your eyes closed.
map.长度递增：从 3 位起逐步加长，记录最佳。: The length increases: start at 3 digits and grow gradually, recording the best.
map.脑力锻炼：适合注意力与记忆训练。: Brain exercise: suitable for attention and memory training.
map.把长串分 3~4 位一组、赋予意义（像记手机号），比逐位硬记更稳。: Splitting a long string into groups of 3-4 digits and giving them meaning (like a phone number) works better than memorizing digit by digit.
